idea-plugin.name: Shaderlyn
idea-plugin.description:
Finds errors in shaders as you edit: Unity ShaderLab and HLSL, Unreal Engine, GLSL, Godot, Slang and WGSL. The analysis runs in the same language server as the Shaderlyn extensions for VS Code and Visual Studio, and reports the same diagnostics.

  • Diagnostics in the editor and the Problems tool window
  • Quick fixes for diagnostics with a single correct fix, and suppression comments

Rider's own shader support (completion, hover, navigation) stays as it is; Shaderlyn adds diagnostics and code actions. Rule severities are configured in .shaderlyn.yaml. The language server is bundled with the plugin and runs locally. The plugin does not collect telemetry.

Documentation (in Japanese): github.com/OmojiP/shaderlyn

Unity・Unreal Engine・Godot・Slang・WGSL などのシェーダーの誤りを、エディタで指摘します。 Rider 自身のシェーダーの支援 (補完・ホバーなど) はそのまま使い、Shaderlyn の指摘とコードアクションを加えます。
